# Lenovo's early Black Friday laptop deals could save you up to $700 — here are 5 I'd recommend on Yoga, ThinkPad, and Legion gaming machines

 By Alex Whitelock 

 Published 10 November 2026 

There's no need to wait until Black Friday for great Lenovo discounts

 (Image credit: Future) 

Black Friday has always been one of (if not the) best times of the entire year to get a brand-new laptop and I'm already seeing excellent early deals at leading retailers this week. Over at the official Lenovo Store, for example, you can save some serious cash on everything from reliable work machines to high-end gaming laptops.

I've been scanning through Lenovo's early Black Friday sale today, and I've found five listings that I think are particularly good value. You can check out my highlights just below.

• Check out all of today's early Black Friday laptop deals at Lenovo

They start with this Lenovo Yoga 7i for $799 (was $1,349), which I think is a great option for an everyday Windows machine. Not only is it decently powerful with an Intel Core 5 chipset and 16GB of RAM, but it doesn't break the bank thanks to today's price cut at Lenovo.

On the higher end, I'd recommend checking out this Lenovo Legion 5 gaming laptop for $1,499 (was $2,226). It's a little pricey, but this machine is a fantastic choice for gamers thanks to its RTX 5060 graphics card, Ryzen 7 chipset, and stunning 1600p OLED display. In short, it's worth every penny if you want all your favorite games to look their best.

...

Note that we have a Lenovo coupon codes page that could potentially save you even more on laptops at the manufacturer this week, so don't hesitate to check that out too.

## Early Black Friday laptop deals are live at Lenovo

Processor: Intel Core Ultra 5 226V RAM: 16GB Storage: 1TB

It's getting harder and harder to find a decent, cheap laptop these days, but this Yoga 7i at the official Lenovo Store is a great choice. Under the hood, the combination of an Intel Core 5 chipset and 16GB of RAM means you've got a decent amount of power here — and the 1TB storage drive gets you plenty of space. While still a little on the pricey end, this excellent 2-in-1 16-inch laptop is a great investment that should last you a few good years. 

Processor: Intel Core Ultra 7 256V RAM: 16GB Storage: 512GB

I'd check out this Lenovo ThinkBook 14x if you're looking for something with some power. With 16GB of RAM and an Intel Core 7 chipset, you'll have no issues tackling even relatively intensive workloads with this machine. While it's not a gaming laptop or the like, this one is perfect for working from home or professional use, especially if you'd prefer a smaller, more portable 14-inch machine. 

Graphics card: RTX 3050 Processor: Intel Core Ultra 7 256V RAM: 16GB Storage: 512GB

A gaming laptop with an entry-level RTX 3050 graphics card will never be more than a 'budget' orientated option, but you'd be surprised at how many games still run well on this aging hardware. Subsequently, this Lenovo LOQ is a good choice if you're a gamer who just needs the basics. Even if you're not a gamer, the combination of an Intel Core Ultra 7 chipset and 16GB of RAM is pretty good at this price since you can still tackle a lot of demanding applications outside of gaming. 

Processor: Intel Core 7 240H RAM: 16GB Storage: 512GB

The ThinkPad series is well-renowned for its bulletproof reliability, which is one of the reasons you see these machines in offices everywhere. Of course, they're not cheap, but this E16 has a decent price cut at Lenovo today and some great components for professional use. With an Intel Core 7 chipset and 16GB of RAM, this is a great working-from-home Windows 11 laptop. 

Graphics card: RTX 5060 Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 260 Processor RAM: 16GB Storage: 1TB

This Lenovo Legion 5 gets my personal recommendation as the best gaming laptop deal in the official retailer's sale this week. Not only do you get a powerful RTX 5060 graphics card and a Ryzen 7 chipset, but this machine also features a high-end 1600p OLED display, which goes a long way in justifying its price tag. While expensive, I still think this one is well worth the money.

title: Hurry! One of our favorite XPS laptops is $600 off right now | Tom's Guide
text:
# Hurry! One of our favorite XPS laptops is $600 off right now

 By Grace Dean 

 Published 10 November 2026 

This premium Windows laptop just got more affordable

 (Image credit: Tom's Guide) 

Picking up a new laptop can be costly, especially with the RAM crisis making new tech even more expensive. Thankfully, this hasn't stopped Dell from putting on a sale — and even better news, they've discounted one of the newest models in its laptop line-up.

For a limited time, you can pick up the Dell XPS 14 on sale for $2,399. That's $600 off on the best Windows laptop we've tested. And if you're happy with the basic configuration, you can pick it up for just $1,699 at Dell, which is a $450 discount.

The Dell XPS 14 is one of the best laptops we've reviewed with a more practical design, a gorgeous OLED panel option, strong Panther Lake performance, and an epic battery life (an average of 12 hours and 23 minutes in our testing). This $600 saving is on the same config that we tested, which led to a four-and-a-half start review.

It was a choppy time when Dell decided on rebranding to Dell Premium, but it didn't take long for it to change its mind. When the Dell XPS 14 returned triumphantly, we were more than keen to get our hands on it — and gave it a four-and-a-half star review. And right now, it's down to just $2,399 at Dell.

The Dell XPS 14 has wildly impressive spec sheet in this $600 discounted config, which matches the one we tested. We're talking Intel Core Ultra 7 358H, 32GB RAM, 1 TB SSD, Intel Arc Graphics and a bonkers battery life making it more than capable for everyday work.

Plus, a full design makes it lighter than the previous model (just 3 pounds) with a CNC-machined aluminum chassis featuring softer, rounded corners. All things considered, our expert tester said: "Not only is this a brilliant redemption story, it's also a fantastic Windows laptop that offers stunning performance and strong battery life in an elegant, refined design."

So, if you're looking for an ultraportable Windows laptop that'll save you money, then this is a deal you might find hard to ignore (in fact, I recommend you don't!)

title: PSA: the best laptop deals at Dell this Black Friday are likely to be for students — this is why the XPS 13 and 14S are highlights | TechRadar
text:
# PSA: the best laptop deals at Dell this Black Friday are likely to be for students — this is why the XPS 13 and 14S are highlights

 By Alex Whitelock 

 Published 11 November 2026 

Both the Dell XPS 13 and Dell 14S stand out as affordable options currently

 (Image credit: Future) 

If you're on the hunt for a new Windows laptop, then the official Dell Store is always a fantastic choice on Black Friday. Like many other leading retailers, Dell has already launched an early holiday sale, which you can check out this week to scope out any potential upgrades.

While the discounts cover everything from high-end gaming laptops to efficient working-from-home machines this week, two deals in particular have caught my eye. They're Dell's listings on the latest XPS 13 and 14S laptops, which include discounts for students specifically.

With an eligible student discount, you can currently get the Dell XPS 13 for $649 (was $749) and the Dell 14S for $649 (was $749), which are the cheapest listings you'll find at the official Dell Store this week.

Both laptops feature a premium design, 8GB of RAM, and an Intel Core 5 chipset in their baseline configuration, meaning they're great if you just want a stylish laptop to cover the basics.

Of the two, the XPS 13 features a lighter and thinner design with a slightly higher-end display, but the 14S features a larger 512GB SSD. If storage is a concern, then the Dell 14S is the obvious choice since it's just as powerful and almost as portable as the stunning XPS 13.

...

Display - 13.4 inches Processor - Intel Core 5 RAM - 8GB Storage - 256GB

The Dell XPS 13 has regularly been one of our favorite laptops here at TechRadar, and this brand-new version continues that trend. With an Intel Core 5 processor and 8GB of RAM, it has everything you need for solid all-around performance at work or college. The only downside here is that this particular machine only features a rather small 256GB storage drive. 

Display - 14 inches Processor - Intel Core 5 RAM - 8GB Storage - 512GB

The new Dell 14s is a great new premium entry in the brand's lineup, slotting into the range ever-so-slightly below the XPS 13. You miss out on the slightly snazzier design and higher-end display, but make up for it with the larger storage drive, which is almost always handy since 256GB doesn't go far these days. 

Most laptop listings at Dell these days run upwards of $1,000 due to the ongoing components shortage, so the above student deals really stand out as more affordable options to me.

It's highly likely we'll see more sub-$1,000 machines at Dell over the next few weeks as the retailer continually updates its holiday sale, but I doubt we'll see any close to $749 unless we're really lucky. Students definitely have a rare opportunity to save some cash here.

title: Acer's Swift 16 AI laptop drops below $1,000 before Black Friday — with Intel's latest CPU and a gorgeous 3K OLED touchscreen | Windows Central
text:
Acer's Swift 16 AI laptop drops below $1,000 before Black Friday — with Intel's latest CPU and a gorgeous 3K OLED touchscreen | Windows Central

# Acer's Swift 16 AI laptop drops below $1,000 before Black Friday — with Intel's latest CPU and a gorgeous 3K OLED touchscreen

 By Alexander Cope Contributions by Ben Wilson 

 Published 6 November 2026 3 min read 

With a Core Ultra X7 358H processor, OLED touchscreen, and long battery life, Acer's Swift 16 AI is a great buy.

 The Acer Swift 16 AI laptop on display. (Image credit: Tom's Guide (Tony Polanco) | Acer) 

The Swift 16 AI is one of the latest Windows laptops featuring Intel's "Panther Lake" processors (Core Ultra Series 3) that balance productivity, power, and efficiency for all-day battery life, plus Acer's stunning OLED touchscreen.

It's already on sale for just $999.99 at Best Buy long before Black Friday, with a hefty $550 discount that knocks 35% off its listing price. With 16GB of RAM and 1TB of storage, it's a great option for anyone looking to upgrade their everyday laptop without spending the usual ~$1,200+ costs.

...

Powered by Intel's Core Ultra Series 3 "Panther Lake" X7 358H processor and integrated Arc B390 graphics, the Swift 16 AI delivers plenty of performance for everyday productivity workloads, including multitasking across dozens of browser tabs, content creation, and even some gaming. That integrated B390 graphics chip is far more powerful than its lower-end variants; in fact, you'll find the same one in high-end gaming handhelds.

Beyond that, Acer boasts a full day of usable battery life in a laptop with a thin chassis and a sharp 3K (2880x1800) OLED touchscreen. That means vibrant colors, strong contrast, and even a super-smooth 120Hz refresh rate as a bump over the usual 60Hz standard you'd find in many others.

...

Acer's bigger trackpad might not suit everyone, and the speakers were never made for movie-watching, but neither detracts from what is otherwise a well-rounded productivity laptop. Alternatively, an AMD-based Swift 16 AI with a WUXGA (1920x1200) touchscreen is also on sale for $799.99 at Walmart. However, it is sold by a reseller, not Walmart itself, so there's a chance it will disappear much faster.

### Should I wait for Black Friday for a better deal?

Even if you're hesitant to buy before Black Friday, Best Buy's 'Price Match Guarantee' may allow eligible customers to request a refund of the difference if Best Buy lowers its own price during the applicable return window: "If our price goes lower during the holiday season, we’ll match it."

title: Lenovo Legion 7a Gen 11 with 32 GB RAM, stunning 165 Hz OLED gets $700 discount
text:
Times are tough for gamers. With the price of almost every critical gaming PC/laptop component going up, finding a good deal on a gaming machine is easier said than done. The main categories where gamers can currently hope to score a good gaming system are discounted pre-built desktop gaming PCs and gaming laptops on sale. The latest example of the latter is the Lenovo Legion 7a Gen 11 gaming laptop that has scored a massive $700 price cut at Best Buy.

The Lenovo Legion 7a Gen 11 is currently on sale for just $1,849.99 at Best Buy. The laptop is powered by a beastly AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 388 APU, 32 GB of LPDDR5X-8000 RAM, and 1 GB of storage. The notebook also packs a stunning 15.3-inch 1600p OLED display with a 165 Hz refresh rate, a single-zone RGB keyboard, and a large glass touchpad.

Moreover, the laptop packs plenty of ports, which include three Type-C ports, two Type-A ports, and more. There is also a 84 Wh battery that keeps the lights on. Finally, the whole machine weighs under 1.5 kg (3.42 lbs).

Now, the discounted price of the Lenovo Legion 7a on sale is not exactly breathtaking. Ideally, it should’ve been much lower. But we need to keep in mind the current consumer tech landscape. For instance, a single 32 GB DDR5 RAM kit currently costs around $480 on Amazon. Add in the inflated prices of other components, and you can see how the Legion 7a 15 Gen 11 on sale is not a bad deal.

...

The Lenovo Legion 7a Gen 11 lacks a discrete GPU. This might trouble some prospective buyers. However, the Ryzen AI Max+ 388 APU’s built-in Radeon 8060S iGPU is powerful enough to rival discrete mobile GPUs. Our in-depth testing of the Radeon 8060S proves that the iGPU rivals cards like the RTX 4070 laptop GPU and is in close proximity to the RTX 5060 laptop GPU.

...

In short, the Lenovo Legion 7a Gen 11 gaming laptop on sale is a pretty good deal in the current market. Hook up good gaming peripherals, like a good gaming mouse, to the machine, and you’ll have a setup that will keep you satisfied for years to come.
